module: Proof of concept: generates an SVG image (2048x2048) of the map's road network (map.getMap()) with a red dot per vehicle on each call of update(). Loaded with require('utils/heatmap'). Used to visualize trajectories; the image is written with the libs/EzSVG library.
usage:
local heatmap = require('utils/heatmap')
heatmap.init('trace.svg')
-- every frame: heatmap.update()
heatmap.destroy() -- saves then frees
notes: Size fixed at 2048 (terrainSize), not read from the terrain (comment in the code); coordinates are offset by the TerrainBlock position and the Y axis is inverted.
Roads whose link value (difficulty) is < 0.7: brown (dirt), otherwise black. Width = 2 x node radius.
init() assumes a TerrainBlock exists in the scene (scenetree.findClassObjects('TerrainBlock')[1]): crashes otherwise.
update() adds one SVG circle per vehicle per call: the document grows every frame.
destroy() calls save() before freeing; init() calls destroy() first, which saves the old document if any (into the NEW file name, because filename has already been replaced).

init.desc: Creates the SVG document, remembers the terrain position and draws the map's roads and nodes.

update.desc: To be called every frame (including in menus, without 3D rendering): draws a red circle at the position of each object in map.objects.

save.desc: Writes the current SVG to the file chosen at init(). Does nothing if there is no document.

destroy.desc: Saves then frees the document and the terrain position.
